svg.description: An SVG document owned by the publisher. This 1.0 check only requires an svg element. The strict subset applies to descriptor.icon. Contract examples use a placeholder mark. See docs/evaluator-descriptor.md.

version.description: Version of the evaluator that produced, or is asked to produce, this document.

kind.description: Selects the payload. scenario grades one trial's steps and produces robot results. integrity judges whether the run and the test system can be trusted and produces a test-system status and findings.

execution.description: Whether the evaluator follows a fixed procedure or an agentic one. capability-verifier records the same idea on an assessor as type agent. This contract uses the word agentic and does not accept agent in this field.

display_name.description: The evaluator's name. A 1.1 descriptor title, when present, is this same string. Consumers show it as written and do not append the word evaluator.

input_ref.description: A reference to an artifact the evaluator reads. The result cites the same bytes the request named.
